Sen. Gillibrand: The Senate will vote on the nomination of Supreme Court Justice Kavanaugh
September 11, 2018 by O.Kay Henderson
Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand (D-NY), the top Democrat on the Senate Judiciary Committee, said on Twitter Saturday that the Senate will vote on the nomination of Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh later on Saturday.
